reviews.t: New love with an old time product
reviews.x: I used to enjoy the delightful scent as my grandmother used rose water and glycerin. As I have very sensitive skin, finding facial products can be a challenge. This winter as I searched for a protector for dry,harsh weather I found Hertiages Rosewater and Glycerin. Very shortly after twice a day use my face was showing the benefits of toning ,moisture, and a healthy glow. Now I use it as a base under my tinted moisturizer for an even application . I have purchased products from Heritage before a

There are a lot of rosewaters out there and this one is my favorite.  It smells heavenly and really hydrates your skin.  Perfect for the summer when your skin is exposed to the sun and excellent in the winter when your skin is parched from frigid climates.  It works great for setting your makeup also.  I spray it all over my body!

reviews.t: If you want your makeup to look like "skin"
reviews.x: I use this to set my makeup. This is much cheaper than Scindinavia, and works just as well if not better. Sometimes I go a little crazy with makeup, ya know, layers of foundation, concealer, blush, bronzer, contouring, and then I like to powder bake to make my lines go away. At the end,  there are so many layers that look great on camera, but in real life- everyone can tell you have makeup on. So I spray this 4-10 times all over, and it doesn't erase the work I've done on my face- it just makes

I've been using this for years as a facial toner per my 85 year old grandmother's beautiful skin. She swears by this and Glycerin is the main ingredient in so many expensive products these days. It's too heavy for me to use on it's own, and I like the the smell of these two mixed together. I couldn't find it for a while at my health store, and I would make my own mixture then.  I use on a cotton ball or directly on my face before moisturizer and makeup. Works great for dry winter skin and gettin

reviews.t: Great basic for winter skin & other things
reviews.x: I LOVE LOVE LOVE this version of rosewater and glycerin! The rose smell is authentic (i use it as aromatherapy and as a body mist) but the glycerin really soothes itchy, dry and irritated skin. A must for before you put on makeup. Great for when the air is really really dry and you want to moisten up you face for a dewey appearance.  If you want more LOVE in your life keep yourself misted & this does the trick.  Rose is a great attractant for more love. People always seem to lighten up & chill o

This is high quality rose water-- made with actual roses and not just rose scent. I mix it with vitamin C powder to make my own C serum treatment, and my skin has been looking really great. You can also use this rosé water as a toner or a light moisturizer. Really fantastic product.

I use this as a toner.  I mix it in a separate bottle and use half of it and half Bragg apple cider vinegar.  I don't mind the smell of the vinegar and it does disappear quickly.  My face is clean, fresh and my pores have gotten smaller.

I guess I got a bad bottle. I was going to return it, but I won't trouble myself over six bucks.  The effort to return is just not worth my hassle.  My aunt had the most silky soft skin I admired as a child. Her secret "rosewater and glycerin". This product is not it. I was expecting a bit of oiliness from glycerin. I expected that delightful rose fragrance. I got nothing but pink water with a very light smell that dissipated quickly. No nice feel on the skin either. What a waste of money and su

Glycerin is wonderful. The scent is lovely and heavenly. This was my first time to buy glycerin, and I will buy this scent again! It has multiple uses; and I am a novice right now. It was wonderful to apply to skin. Moisturized really well and smelled divine. I even used it on my face. I have heard it is a wonderful base for making lotions and other home made products. I loved this glycerin. It came fast in wonderful packaging. Totally a great experience.

This is an amazing moisturizer to use after face washes. My routine in Clearasil Sensative Daily Wash, Epsom salt mask, and then Rosewater and Glycerin. It keeps the skin blemish free and soft!  It's perfect for my sensitive skin. It does not cause breakouts. It give that extra glow and it has a fresh and natural smell.

reviews.t: Buy the one in the atomizer.
reviews.x: This has a nice smell and gives my skin a dewy look. However, it's really difficult to apply. I either end up pouring half of it down my arm, or wasting half of it by it being absorbed on a cotton round. Probably do a better job in an atomizer. I'll purchase that next time.

reviews.t: It has a super strong smell
reviews.x: It has a super strong smell, but it goes away almost instantly when it dries. To be honest, I don't know how much this has changed my skin, mostly because I wasn't paying enough attention when I first started using it. It definitely does add moisture though, which is what I most needed it for.

I love rosewater and glycerin! Use to use it years ago........beautifully delicate rose fragrance which I use on my face, mix with lotion and face cream and have even used it on my hair when I want a touch of moisture in order to braid my hair for waves.

Really, really great for dry, flaky skin.  Just a little bit in the palm of hand, and then massage into the tops and between the fingers.  Smells divine too.  I use it just before going to sleep, so I can drift off to the scent of roses.
i thought this was going to be oily, but it came and it is like water! not a bad thing, but i was suprised.  feels great to splash on my face and neck and arms whenever im feeling meh.
I could not find this product in my local stores. Love to put a little on linens...bring back childhood memories.

I love this product! After watching many youtube beauty gurus use this product as a primer ( prep before applying foundation), I had to try it out myself and at such an affordable cost, why not?  I put a little bit of the rosewater on a cotton pad and apply it thinly to my face and let it absorb into my skin for a few minutes. After that , I apply my foundation on top and do the rest of my makeup. Im not entirely sure if this product keeps my makeup on or not BUT the super nice but not overly po

I put this in a small spray bottle and spritz my face with it.  It is so refreshing.  I plan to buy some more.  I do recommend that you empty this bottle into a spray bottle to use.  At first I just splashed some in my hand and face, but that seemed wasteful as the rosewater ending up in the floor.

We purchased this to use in a natural hair care recipe for curly hair. It leaves my sons curly hair looking and smelling fabulous. In a spray bottle mix equal parts of this and water with a small amount of witch hazel. Spray down those curls, tame with fingers, and let air dry.

reviews.t: There are no similar products in the market better than this
reviews.x: There are no similar products in the market better than this.  I have been using it for a few years and I love it!
It is what it says it is. Smells like Roses, made of glycerin water. I use it to cut lotions.

I probably made a mistake by ordering this product--but that isn't the fault of the product.  I was looking for glycerin to add to some shaving soap that isn't quite lubricating enough for my taste.  As I use mostly unscented products, I thought the rosewater might be a nice addition.  Clearly I was taking a risk.  Well the scent isn't my cup-o-tea, but mostly I found this isn't really a glycerin you would add to a lather.  It really is a post-shave product.  So with that in mind, it is probably

I used this for two types of DIY conconctions. Once DIY hair and DIY skin lotions. The DIY hair had a mix of cayenne pepper and Dr. Adorable Peppermint Castor oil. I yielded 2.5' of new growth within 3 weeks doing the greenhouse method. For the DIY lotion, I used several oils, lotions with this rosewater and glycerin water and added epsom salt and have had the best exfoliating lotion ever. I have no dry skin on my body. My skin is smooth and the glycerin has allowed the lotions to enter into the

I bought this to make my own toner. I have oily skin at the age of 40. I used the homemade toner for 2 weeks and my face broke out more. The recipe was equal part rosewater glycerine and apple cider vinegar. The rose scent helps cover the vinegar smell but my face broke out more. I may try again since it was a season change and there could be other factors causing the breakout. Not sure it will work for me and I have no other need for this item.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the pleasant rose scent, describing it as heavenly, lovely, or divine.
Many reviewers report that it effectively moisturizes and hydrates dry, sensitive, or flaky skin.
Several reviewers use it as a facial toner or makeup setting spray and find it works well for that purpose.
A few reviewers note the product is watery and difficult to apply without an atomizer or spray bottle.
One reviewer received a disappointing bottle that did not match expectations.
